'''Foocl'd''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who served aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
